candidates.prompt: One square icon on pure white: A blue tag beside one large green circular status light. Symbolize checking a software tag status. Thick simple flat geometry, generous margins, no text, border or shadow.

signature.composition: A blue tag beside one large green circular status light.

source.evidence: A blue tag is accompanied by a green light, which depicts a successful status rather than retrieving an arbitrary status.

30x18.evidence: The circle has no retrieval cue and depends solely on green for meaning.

16x16.evidence: Tag and green circle remain visible.
